name: Indo Euro Indchem Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1990, Indo Euro Ind Chem Ltd manufactures and trades in paper and other merchandise.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
a) IEICL is in the business of Pigment and Organic Chemical.
b) It ventured into new business and also started trading of Laminates, Speciality Chemicals, and Poultry feed
b) It imports  Base Paper, Press Plate, Tissue paper, Laminates, etc.
d) The company also trades in Organic and Inorganic Chemicals, Chemical Products, Alkalies, Acids, Solvents, Chemical Auxiliaries, Pesticides, Caustic Soda, Soda Ash, Petrochemicals, Dyes and Intermediates, Rubber Chemicals, Textile Auxiliaries, Industrial Chemicals, Poultry Feeds, Base Paper, Press Plates, Tissue Paper, Laminates

pros: Stock is trading at 0.89 times its book value
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 3.02% over last 3 years.
Company has high debtors of 364 days.
